subject: StratusChannel marketplace listing & evaluation plan — kickoff and owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@stratuschannel.com>, Priya Menon <pm@stratuschannel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 21:05:00 +0000
Subject: StratusChannel marketplace listing & evaluation plan — kickoff and owners

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for committing to a marketplace listing with Redwood. I want to kick off a concise mutual action plan (MAP) so we align on owners, evaluation expectations, and the close timeline. I attached a working MAP spreadsheet and an evaluation matrix to seed the conversation.

Proposed high-level timeline (flexible):
- MAP kickoff / owners confirmed: this week (target: Jul 12)
- Evaluation window (customer trials + perf tests): Jul 29 - Aug 12
- Procurement & contract finalization: Aug 13 - Aug 26
- Marketplace listing submission (first pass): Jul 29 (submission to AWS/GCP/Azure with partner metadata)

Suggested owners (initial):
- Redwood: Kimberly Park (seller enablement lead), Marissa Cole (platform ops / eval lead), Rishi Malhotra (contracts & procurement)
- StratusChannel: Alex Ruiz (partner PM), Priya Menon (technical lead)
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace Ops (listing process)

Attachments included: Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), evaluation_matrix_v1.csv (test cases). Please confirm any missing stakeholders and whether you want the evaluation window shifted earlier/later.

Quick asks from our side:
1) Can Priya confirm who will be the Stratus technical contact for prelisting tests and whether you can provision an integration account by Jul 26?
2) Alex — any procurement constraints we should be aware of (PO timelines, legal redlines)?
3) AWS ops — can you share the exact listing checklist / IDs we should reference for partner-enablement?

If helpful, I can set a 30-minute sync tomorrow to run through the MAP and lock owners. Proposed times: Jul 12 10:00 AM PT or 2:00 PM PT.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx (workbook), evaluation_matrix_v1.csv (CSV of test cases)

From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@stratuschannel.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priya Menon <pm@stratuschannel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 23:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: StratusChannel marketplace listing & evaluation plan — kickoff and owners

Kimberly — thanks for pulling this together. Priya and I reviewed the MAP and are aligned on the approach. A few quick notes: 

- Priya will be the technical lead and can own the integration account creation; she expects to have an account provisioned by Jul 24 (we'll fast-track).
- Our procurement team requires a standard SOW + the marketplace listing terms; legal may want to see a draft contract before the procurement window opens. I'll introduce our legal contact if needed.
- The evaluation window Jul 29 - Aug 12 works for us; if Redwood needs extra time for performance tuning we can extend by one week.

I've added two internal Stratus contacts to the thread: Priya Menon (pm@stratuschannel.com) and our legal lead Miguel Santos (miguel.santos@stratuschannel.com). Please note Miguel is optional until we hit contract redlines.

Next steps from our side:
1) Priya will confirm integration account credentials and test data access by Jul 24.
2) I'll review the MAP and propose any role tweaks by Jul 13.
3) We can take the 30-minute sync on Jul 12 at 2:00 PM PT — that time works.

Appreciate the clear plan. Looking forward to the sync.

— Alex Ruiz
Director, Channel Partnerships | StratusChannel
alex.ruiz@stratuschannel.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@stratuschannel.com>, Priya Menon <pm@stratuschannel.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 00:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: StratusChannel marketplace listing & evaluation plan — kickoff and owners

Thanks Alex — great. A couple of technical/eval details from Redwood ops so everyone is clear on expectations for the evaluation window:

- Evaluation goals: 1) functional validation of the integration, 2) latency/throughput perf at target concurrency, 3) cost-per-token baseline for marketplace SKU pricing.
- Test harness: Redwood will host a temporary eval harness and provide a limited number of eval API keys (scoped) for Stratus test accounts. We'll need the integration account credentials and a small sample dataset (anonymized) by Jul 24 to pre-seed caches.
- Success criteria (samples in evaluation_matrix_v1.csv): basic generation correctness (pass/fail), 95th pctl latency under 250ms for 16-token requests at 20 concurrent connections, and quantized cost estimates within 15% of our baseline.

On the MAP itself I added an "action owner" column and a near-term checklist (see Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx). Please confirm: can Stratus support two parallel integration nodes (for failover) during the evaluation weeks?

On quoting Alex's earlier note:
> Priya will be the technical lead and can own the integration account creation; she expects to have an account provisioned by Jul 24 (we'll fast-track).

That timeline works for Redwood. If anything slips, tell us by Jul 22 so we can reschedule the submission.

I'll take the Jul 12 2:00 PM PT sync and run through the MAP and evaluation matrix. Agenda: 1) owners & access, 2) evaluation scenarios, 3) listing prerequisites and procurement touchpoints. 30 minutes should be enough.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Platform Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: evaluation_matrix_v1.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@stratuschannel.com>, Priya Menon <pm@stratuschannel.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: StratusChannel marketplace listing & evaluation plan — kickoff and owners

Adding procurement confirmations from Redwood's side:

- I've attached a procurement checklist (procurement_checklist.pdf) and a zip with the initial responses to the security questionnaire (security_questionnaire_responses.zip) — please review and flag gaps.
- For contracts: we can start with Redwood's standard marketplace SOW template. Alex, if Stratus needs a redline, please send by Aug 2 so both legal teams have time.
- DocuSign link (pre-populated): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning?env=na1&acct=12345 — we'll send the vendor SOW once commercial terms are agreed.

Confirming internal target dates (aligning to MAP):
- Submission first-pass to marketplace: 2027-07-29
- Evaluation window: 2027-07-29 to 2027-08-12
- Procurement window / contract sign: target Aug 13 - Aug 26

If Stratus can confirm integration account by Jul 24 and legal review timing, we should be on track. I'll coordinate the procurement cadence with Alex once he introduces Miguel.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Contracts & Finance, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: procurement_checklist.pdf, security_questionnaire_responses.zip
